name: fastcompute
description: Trusted peer compute exchange for Windows
author: FastCompute

scripts.check: node --check desktop/main.cjs && node --check desktop/network.cjs && node --check desktop/worker.cjs && node --check desktop/google.cjs && node --check ui/app.js && node --check ui/market.js
scripts.dist: node scripts/prepare-release.cjs && node scripts/make-icon.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:preview: node scripts/prepare-release.cjs --preview && node scripts/make-icon.cjs && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --publish never --config.nsis.artifactName=FastCompute-Preview-${version}-${arch}.${ext}
